_comment: High/critical npm advisories the CI audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) tolerates. Each entry needs a reason; remove it once the fix lands.

advisories.GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5: zod 3: memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections. Only fixed in zod 4, a major upgrade; zod 3 is also required by @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit's WalletConnect/viem stack. Here zod only validates backend API responses (app/lib/api_schemas.ts).
